name: Sciron
source:
Leader of the Resistance in Goatown, a Mainland port. Although he was born on the Mainland, he is Unblessed. To fund the Resistance, he does smuggling business with pirates and other contacts from the Outer Islands.

[From [url=https://pirahus.com/en/]official website[/url]]
